scripts.format: pnpm --recursive --if-present format && uv run ruff format apps/api scripts/foundation-model-fixture.py
scripts.format:check: pnpm --recursive --if-present format:check && uv run ruff format --check apps/api scripts/foundation-model-fixture.py
scripts.lint: pnpm architecture:check && pnpm ui:check && pnpm --recursive --if-present lint && uv run ruff check apps/api scripts/foundation-model-fixture.py
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck && uv run mypy apps/api/src
